title: Magyar Elektronikus Könyvtár (MEK)
notes: Hungarian Electronic Library (MEK), the digital library of the National Széchényi Library. Most of the texts come from MEK; three poems (Gyöngyösi's Murányi Vénus and Phoenix, Esterházy's Egy csudálatos ének) were taken from the Syrena site of the Department of Old Hungarian Literature, ELTE (magyar-irodalom.elte.hu/syrena). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
